title: ShIOEnv: A Command Evaluation Environment for Grammar-Constrained Synthesis and Execution Behavior Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2505.18374v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce ShIOEnv, a Gymnasium-compatible Bash environment for synthesizing execution-annotated shell input traces. Datasets containing such traces are useful for training models to perform execution-free shell simulation, which in turn is useful for deploying honeypots for cyber deception. Existing datasets, such as NL2CMD and other Bash command corpora, do not include complete execution artifacts (stdout, stderr, exit status, and changes to the system's state) associated with a command's execution. ShIOEnv synthesizes shell inputs, executes them in a controlled system context, and records stdout, stderr, exit status, and structured filesystem and environment patches. Unconstrained (random) generation of shell inputs (command and arguments) results in multiple instances of arguments that are mostly redundant or result in execution errors. translated_title: ShIOEnv：一个用于语法约束合成与执行行为建模的命令评估环境
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了ShIOEnv，一个与Gymnasium兼容的Bash环境，用于合成带有执行标注的shell输入轨迹。包含此类轨迹的数据集对于训练模型执行无需实际执行的shell模拟非常有用，这进而有助于部署用于网络欺骗的蜜罐。现有数据集（如NL2CMD及其他Bash命令语料库）不包含与命令执行相关的完整执行产物（标准输出、标准错误、退出状态以及系统状态的变化）。ShIOEnv能够合成shell输入，在受控的系统上下文中执行它们，并记录标准输出、标准错误、退出状态以及结构化的文件系统和环境补丁。无约束（随机）生成的shell输入（命令和参数）会产生大量冗余或导致执行错误的参数实例。我们引入语法约束合成方法来生成语法上有效且覆盖度高的参数……
tldr: ShIOEnv是一个与Gymnasium兼容的Bash命令评估环境，通过语法约束合成生成有效的shell输入，并记录完整的执行产物（标准输出、标准错误、退出状态和系统状态变化），为训练无需执行的shell模拟模型和部署网络欺骗蜜罐提供数据支持。
en_tdlr: ShIOEnv is a Gymnasium-compatible Bash environment that employs grammar-constrained synthesis to generate valid shell inputs and records complete execution artifacts (stdout, stderr, exit status, and system state changes), enabling training of execution-free shell simulation models for cyber deception honeypots.
